Looping in my notes on the redline below — high-level suggestions before we talk to Beacon: 

1) Governing law: propose Delaware with a carve that choice of law applies but not exclusive forum for provisional relief. Language: "This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflict-of-law principles, except that either party may seek provisional injunctive or other equitable relief in any court of competent jurisdiction as necessary to preserve the status quo."

2) Injunctive relief: craft a short emergency-relief process: written notice to support team + 48-hour escalation to VP/legal, with right to seek emergency court relief if material harm is imminent. Limit remedies to narrowly tailored injunctions tied to specific alleged breaches. 

3) Arbitration: carve out claims seeking provisional equitable relief from arbitration. For monetary claims, suggest threshold $250k with JAMS/AAA and venue default to Delaware. 

I'll draft suggested language and share a tracked version by EOD. If Beacon insists on CA governing law, ask: (a) why CA (tax/contractual history?), and (b) whether they will accept our provisional-relief carve.

- Laura
